capabilities.name: wc-loan-list-read
capabilities.description: Read the m_wc_loan list as returned by GET /working-capital-loans. The pinned capture holds one seeded loan (id 1, external id SEED-WC-L01, status active), so the read is exercised and its row is transcribed into a parity vector.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loans-list-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned {"content":[{... id 1, externalId SEED-WC-L01, status loanStatusType.active ...}],"totalElements":1} for the seeded working-capital loan. The list seam grades id, external_id and status (no money cell), and one parity vector is promoted from it.

seams.name: working-capital-loans-list
seams.description: GET /working-capital-loans on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_wc_loan list (one seeded loan in the pinned capture).

note: Working-capital parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). One capability is declared: the working-capital loan list read, which is exercised and returns the single seeded loan. The breach-schedule and delinquency-range-schedule seams are NOT declared as exercised because no breach/delinquency range is configured on the seed and no write path has been captured to observe them; declaring them would be a fabricated observation.
